prompt: My Node service works locally but returns 502 through nginx after it has been idle. What should I check?
expected: Maps client→proxy→app hops; compares Node keepAliveTimeout (default 5s) to nginx upstream keepalive; gathers ss/logs read-only; validates config then reloads before restart.
actual: Core path + Rule 4 name the keepalive inversion; troubleshooting table lists intermittent 502; workflow requires read-only evidence then validate+reload.

prompt: I need to expose a new application safely on a VM.
expected: Unprivileged app on loopback/Unix socket behind a proxy on 80/443; supervised unit with restart policy; confirm before service-affecting commands.
actual: Rules 2 and 7 plus safety defaults require supervision, private bind, proxy-owned public ports, and explicit confirmation for impactful ops.

prompt: A deployment made the service unhealthy; how do I roll back?
expected: Flip current symlink to previous releases/<id>/, reload, verify request path, record incident under state_root — do not rebuild old commit as rollback.
actual: Rule 8 defines release directories + symlink rollback artifact; core path requires verify then durable state recording.

prompt: Uploads fail with HTTP 413 only through the proxy.
expected: Identify body-size limits at every hop; note nginx client_max_body_size default 1m; raise the smallest limit on the path.
actual: Failure signature 413 and defaults table cite client_max_body_size 1m; trap/guidance says smallest hop wins.
